title: Kissed Juicy Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: Fatty and juicy lamb kebabs marinated in a mixture of apple juice and spices, then deep-fried to perfection, this Algerian dish is an energizing treat for any meal
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together apple juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the deep fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and thread onto skewers, if using.
Deep-fry the lamb kebabs for 5-7 minutes or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the kebabs from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the kebabs hot with your choice of sides, such as couscous or roasted vegetables.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Repeat the cooking process for any remaining lamb kebabs.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
